description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Software Engineering topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: software-engineering

facts.claim: System/acceptance testing checks the whole system against requirements

source.quote: The acceptance phase (a.k.a. system testing) is about testing the complete system

facts.claim: Waterfall runs the phases in sequence

source.quote: the typical software development life cycle (SDLC) phases in sequential order

facts.claim: Each phase is completed before the next starts

source.quote: Each phase is completed before the next is started

facts.claim: The spiral model is risk-driven

source.quote: The spiral model is a risk-driven software development process model

facts.claim: Elicitation: developers and stakeholders meet to find needs

source.quote: Developers and stakeholders meet; the latter are inquired concerning their needs and wants

facts.claim: In waterfall, requirements engineering is the first phase

source.quote: requirements engineering is presented as the first phase of the software development process

facts.claim: Validation: meets the needs of users and stakeholders

source.quote: The assurance that a product, service, or system meets the needs of the customer and other identified stakeholders

facts.claim: Verification: complies with the specification

source.quote: complies with a regulation, requirement, specification, or imposed condition

facts.claim: Coupling = interdependence between modules

source.quote: coupling is the degree of interdependence between software modules

facts.claim: Aim for low coupling and high cohesion
facts.pattern: low coupling[^.]{0,60}high cohesion|high cohesion[^.]{0,60}low coupling|loose(ly)? coupl

source.quote: Low coupling often correlates with high cohesion

facts.claim: Number of linearly independent paths

source.quote: the number of linearly independent paths through a program's source code

facts.claim: Equals decision points + 1 (for one entry, one exit)

source.quote: is equal to the number of decision points

facts.claim: White-box testing tests internal structure

source.quote: a method of software testing that tests internal structures or workings

facts.claim: Most tests are unit tests, fewer integration and end-to-end

source.quote: most of the tests are unit tests, followed by a smaller set of integration tests

facts.claim: Maintenance is modifying software after delivery

source.quote: Software maintenance is the modification of software after delivery

facts.claim: Corrective, adaptive, perfective and preventive maintenance

source.quote: Corrective maintenance: modification of software to fix a bug

facts.claim: COCOMO (Boehm, 1981) estimates effort, cost and schedule

source.quote: a model for estimating effort, cost, and schedule for software projects

facts.claim: Effort in person-months from thousands of lines of code

source.quote: where E is the effort applied in person-months, KSLOC is the estimated number of thousands of source lines of code

facts.claim: CMM has five maturity levels

source.quote: at each of the five maturity levels

facts.claim: Its aim is to improve development processes

source.quote: The model's aim is to improve existing software development processes
